title: Release BSC v2 with evidence-based personas and controlled experiments
description: Implement the approved architecture without changing core entities: rubric-based interval BSC v2, blind order-swapped evaluation, frozen evidence-linked profiles and task adaptations, neutral control, balanced repeated trials, truthful metadata and incomplete-run reporting; detailed README diagrams; release 0.2.0.
acceptance_criteria: Focused regression tests demonstrate red then green; deterministic interval scoring and source provenance verified; UI supports protocol/results and preserves pagination/palettes; full JS, browser, Rust checks and native build pass; versioned release artifacts built and release state accurately reported.
notes:
Implementation and local verification complete: BSC v2, provenance, frozen protocol, neutral control, balanced repeated trials, partial traces and paged UI. pnpm check: 81 unit tests and 7 harness tests; Chrome e2e: 26 passing; Rust gate and native binary/macOS app built. Six Mermaid architecture diagrams added across README and architecture docs. Independent scoring/pipeline review found no blockers. Preparing atomic commits and four-platform release; issue remains open until CI publication and artifact verification.
Release verification caught and fixed a Kimi 2.3.2 integration defect: ACP ignored agent-file. Native adapter now uses supported print JSONL, explicit tool policy, encoded request envelope preventing template expansion, short argv, malformed/overflow/failed-final rejection and truthful unavailable Kimi reasoning. Actual Codex and Kimi smoke passed with a marker supplied only through stage instructions; no parser assertions weakened to accept prose. Final native review/build and release publishing pending.
close_reason: Released v0.2.0 from 84d77c9: Release workflow 42208902028 and CI 42208902435 passed all jobs; four installers published and all downloaded SHA-256 checksums verified. Local gates passed: 81 unit tests, 7 harness tests, 26 browser scenarios, 19 native tests, desktop binary and macOS app. Real Codex and Kimi smoke passed with a stage-only instruction marker after fixing ignored Kimi ACP agent-file; print-mode JSONL now enforces profile and tool policy, honestly reports unavailable reasoning, and rejects malformed/overflow/failed output. README and architecture docs contain six Mermaid diagrams. Independent scoring/pipeline/native reviews found no blockers. Release: https://github.com/gnoy-i-salo/proteus/releases/tag/v0.2.0
